title: the rules a member agrees to before publishing a Page

criteria.text: A member becomes a creator by completing one step before publishing a Page, and takes it again before every new Page; creator status derives from the agreement record and authorship: no account type, no stored role column, no mode flag
criteria.note: `group.activate` refuses without `rulesVersion === RULES_VERSION` (1) on every publish and writes one `creator_rules_agreements` row per Page [V]. Checked: `[guards F082.1]` in `tests/f082-rules-before-publish-db.test.tsx`, including a scan that `members` and `groups` carry no role, type, mode or badge column [V]. Reviewed: #326, #493, #908 carry `Reviewed by:`, but #1135 rewrote the step and is unreviewed. Shipped: green on f89b294, 3df9260. Smoked: no smoke route opens the publish card. Re-read 2026-11-27 [V]: `BeforeYouPublish.tsx`, `group.activate`, `creator-rules.ts` and the Terms rules are unchanged since 11-06 (29e04bc added only a Privacy to-do line); #1135 still carries `needs-fix`, "second session pending" and no review.

criteria.text: Agreeing is the attestation; nothing is typed and no free text is stored. Self-attestation only: no document upload, no ID, no selfie, no photo, no third-party lookup, no automated check, no human approval queue
criteria.note: Publish has only the button and "By posting you agree to the Terms"; the agreements table has no free-text column; `group.activate` calls no lookup or queue [V]. Checked: no marker (#1203, open). Reviewed: #1135 unreviewed. Shipped: green on 3df9260. Re-read 2026-11-27 [V]: `BeforeYouPublish.tsx`, `group.activate`, `creator-rules.ts` and the Terms rules are unchanged since 11-06 (29e04bc added only a Privacy to-do line); #1135 still carries `needs-fix`, "second session pending" and no review.

criteria.text: The step is fixed statements, presented as rules with the reason for each, which the member agrees to abide by
criteria.note: Spec conflict: Don, 2026-10-31 (#1135) dropped the rules page and the four-rule step for one Terms line [V BeforeYouPublish.tsx:6, next.config.ts:18]. The scenario still has no dated `## Rulings` line for it [V scenario-F082.md], so it cannot be retired here. Routed to `scope-scenario`.

criteria.text: Nothing attested renders to peers as a badge, tier, score, label or public claim
criteria.note: `creator_rules_agreements` has RLS on, no policy, grants revoked; only `group.activate` names it [V]. Checked: `[guards F082.3]` in `tests/f082-rules-before-publish-db.test.tsx` [V]. Reviewed: #326, #493, #908. Shipped: green on f89b294.

criteria.text: The step gates publishing each new Page, not creating it, selling and hosting alike; creating and editing a draft never asks; browsing, responding, following and attending are untouched
criteria.note: `group.activate` is the only gate; create and draft edits never ask [V]. Checked: `[guards F082.4]` in `activate.test.ts` [V]. Reviewed: #326, #493. Shipped: green on 96b0ea6. #1459 removed a Create menu entry, not the gate [V git show].

criteria.text: No string in the step asks the member to classify themselves as a business, uses legal or tax language, or asks for legal-entity information
criteria.note: The step's strings are the checklist, the missing-parts line and the Terms line; none classifies or asks for entity information [V BeforeYouPublish.tsx]. No standing guard since #1135 deleted it (#1202, open). Reviewed: #1135 unreviewed. Shipped: green on 3df9260.

criteria.text: The rules are versioned: a member who agreed to an earlier version agrees again before they next publish; each agreement is recorded with version and timestamp, seen only by Don and operators
criteria.note: `RULES_VERSION` compared on every publish, the row written in the publish transaction, no client policy [V]. Checked: `[guards F082.6]` x2 in `activate.test.ts` and one in `create/actions.test.ts` [V grep]. Reviewed: #493. Shipped: green on 96b0ea6. "Rules" now means the Terms (see 2b).

criteria.text: The rules are viewable with one click, whether or not the member is taking the step
criteria.note: `/rules` 301s to `/terms` (`next.config.ts:19`), and `/terms` is one click from the Publish card and elsewhere [V]. Checked: unmarked tests (#1204, open). Reviewed: #772 review-skipped, #1135 unreviewed. Shipped: green on 3df9260. Smoked: `/terms` is not in LIVE_PATHS [V evals/smoke/live.spec.ts].

criteria.text: Publishing a Page requires a name, a location (address or area) and a description, with the rules agreement and at least one tag; a photo is optional and a Page without one shows its kind default image
criteria.note: `group.activate` requires name, location and description; "Listed under" is filled from the Page's words so a Page is never unlisted (#1181); photo optional with `DefaultArt` [V]. Checked: `[guards F082.8]` [V]. Reviewed: #326, #493, #908, #1181. Shipped: green on f89b294, 591ab70.

criteria.text: One of the rules is the photo rule: the member agrees not to post pictures of children (draft wording, versioned like the rest)
criteria.note: In the Terms: "No photos of kids, ever. ..." (`src/lib/text-pages.ts:42`), agreed by the Terms line [V]. Checked: `[guards F082.9]` [V]. Reviewed: moved by #1135, unreviewed. Shipped: green on 3df9260.
